title: Category Memory · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Category Memory · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner names four items from the same broad category. The lead names the four items in any order. All four items match the original list without extras. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Category Memory, what counts as a successful turn?
options: All four items match the original list without extras.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: All four items match the original list without extras.
